core_meaning.primary_meaning: Afzal corresponds to the Arabic form أفضل and is glossed in this record as “Better, best, superior.” The record associates the form with root ف ض ل (f-ḍ-l). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Afzal corresponds to the Arabic form أفضل (Arabic root ف ض ل (f-ḍ-l); أَفْضَل (afḍal)). Its core sense is better, best; superior. Afzal is Arabic أَفْضَل (afḍal) 'Better, best, superior', the elative ('better, best') form built on the root ف ض ل (f-ḍ-l).

etymology.etymological_meaning: From the root ف ض ل (f-ḍ-l)

etymology.false_etymology_warning: No derivation beyond the documented Arabic form is asserted. Any etymology that attributes this spelling to a different root or language without a source should be treated as unverified.

persian.name: أفضل
persian.long_meaning: Afzal (أفضل) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن برتر، فاضل، برگزیده است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.
